advice_items.quote: to bring in good people they have to believe in you you know your dream's got to be so big that everybody's dream can fit inside of it
advice_items.summary_en: Attract talented people with a vision big enough for everyone's dreams to fit inside.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用宏大愿景凝聚优秀人才

advice_items.quote: faith is really taking action before you have what you need... when you put money behind something that's when you know you're committed
advice_items.summary_en: Take action before you feel ready and commit resources upfront to force execution.
advice_items.summary_zh: 资源未齐先行动并投入承诺

advice_items.quote: low stress is low performance but when you put yourself in these uncomfortable situations that's when that greatness that lies within comes out
advice_items.summary_en: Put yourself in uncomfortable, high-pressure situations to unlock your highest performance.
advice_items.summary_zh: 主动置身高压环境激发潜能

advice_items.quote: you focus on one thing you become really good at it then that becomes your bread and butter and then you start to diversify
advice_items.summary_en: Master one core cash-flowing business before diversifying into other industries.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先专注深耕单一业务再多元化

advice_items.quote: you have to get obsessed to be great at something like for me I wanted to be great in the home security industry
advice_items.summary_en: Become obsessed with your craft and commit to long-term improvement to reach the top.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持极致痴迷才能做到行业顶尖

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: I would split my check three ways and I would live on a third of it one would go towards IRS and savings and then the other one would go towards a reserve account
advice_items.summary_en: Split every paycheck three ways: live on one-third, set aside taxes and savings, and keep an untouchable reserve.
advice_items.summary_zh: 收入三等分控制生活开销并存储备

advice_items.quote: I was like I'm not leaving here until I get a deal... the reason people don't buy from you is cuz you look desperate
advice_items.summary_en: Persist until you close the deal and project calm confidence rather than desperation when selling.
advice_items.summary_zh: 销售保持自信不显迫切且不达目标不收工

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Build an Abundance Relationship With Money
advice_items.quote: if you're always worried about not having enough money... you start to hoard all of your money... in reality you should become first then take action
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid hoarding money out of scarcity; build an abundance mindset so you can act boldly.
advice_items.summary_zh: 建立富足金钱观而非因恐惧囤钱

advice_items.quote: believing in yourself means believing something in your heart before you actually have it believing that you're worth a million dollar a year
advice_items.summary_en: Believe in your high worth internally before the financial results show up in reality.
advice_items.summary_zh: 在成功之前先发自内心相信自己配得

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Break Goals Down and Set Deadlines
advice_items.quote: break it down to the ridiculous the more you can break it down to the ridiculous the more attainable it becomes... put a date on when you're going to do it by
advice_items.summary_en: Break ambitious goals down into small, attainable daily steps and set strict deadlines.
advice_items.summary_zh: 将宏大目标拆解到极致并设定截止日期

advice_items.quote: right as you're going to get your blessing you're going to get your biggest test... I can't tell you how many times Miracles have happened just cuz I did not quit
advice_items.summary_en: Expect your toughest test right before a breakthrough and refuse to quit when knocked down.
advice_items.summary_zh: 遭遇重创时绝不放弃才能迎来转机

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: for me to make six seven eight figures a year you don't have to be that smart you just need to find an opportunity that allows you to make that kind of money
advice_items.summary_en: Pick an opportunity or industry with enough upside to support the income level you want.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选择天花板足够高的行业与机会

advice_items.quote: you need to find someone who's got a bested interest in your success is going to help you do it
advice_items.summary_en: Find a successful mentor who has a vested interest in helping you succeed.
advice_items.summary_zh: 寻找利益绑定且愿助力你成功的导师

advice_items.quote: 90% of winning in life is just being positive and that's where faith is so important... live inside out which has been the biggest game Cher for me is gratitude exercises
advice_items.summary_en: Choose faith and positivity over fear, and practice daily gratitude to live from the inside out.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持信念、感恩与积极心态克服恐惧

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Don't Confuse Material Pleasure With Happiness
advice_items.quote: I used to think that exterior factors like women exotic cars big houses would give me happiness... those things didn't bring me happiness they brought me pleasure
advice_items.summary_en: Remember that external luxuries bring temporary pleasure rather than lasting happiness.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别把外在物质享乐误当成真正的幸福

advice_items.quote: your subconscious mind filters what information it's going to send to your conscious mind... by the way of the reticular activating system... dreams... selfworth... survival
advice_items.summary_en: Feed your reticular activating system big dreams, self-worth, and urgency so you recognize life-changing opportunities.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用宏大梦想与自我价值感训练潜意识识别机遇

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身贫困，父母入狱后曾住寄养家庭，15岁起养家；21岁辞去7万美元年薪工作创办家庭安防公司，提前买下小货车组建上门推销团队，为兑现90天内给母亲买房的承诺全力销售实现突破。
guests.wealth_detail: $600M+ cumulative business revenue over 25 years; $200M/yr current revenue; multi-million dollar LA home
guests.zero_start_advice: 先想清楚支撑自己的核心动力（Why），寻找能赚取目标收入的行业机会并找到利益绑定的成功导师；将大目标拆解到极致并设死线，在资源未齐时先行动，同时把收入三等分以保障现金储备。
